=INSERT INTO kaspi_fx_rates (day, cbr_date, kzt_rub, vnd_rub)
VALUES ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Moscow')::date,
        '{{ String($json.Date).slice(0, 10) }}',
        {{ $json.Valute.KZT.Value / $json.Valute.KZT.Nominal }},
        {{ $json.Valute.VND ? $json.Valute.VND.Value / $json.Valute.VND.Nominal : 'NULL' }})
ON CONFLICT (day) DO UPDATE SET cbr_date = EXCLUDED.cbr_date, kzt_rub = EXCLUDED.kzt_rub,
       vnd_rub = EXCLUDED.vnd_rub, fetched_at = now()
RETURNING day;

=WITH input AS (
  SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ $('Validate').first().json.sql_json }}'::jsonb) AS x(
    op_local timestamp, op_date date, time_known boolean, merchant text, merchant_norm text,
    type text, amount_kzt numeric, amount_vnd numeric, amount_key text, dedup_key text)
), rate AS (
  -- самый свежий курс: сегодняшний, а если ЦБ не ответил — последний известный
  SELECT * FROM kaspi_fx_rates ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 1
)
INSERT INTO kaspi_expenses (op_at, op_date, time_known, merchant, merchant_norm, type,
       amount_kzt, amount_vnd, amount_rub, rub_source, rate_day, kzt_rub, vnd_rub,
       amount_key, dedup_key, raw_text)
SELECT i.op_local AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', i.op_date, i.time_known, i.merchant, i.merchant_norm, i.type,
       i.amount_kzt, i.amount_vnd,
       round(COALESCE(i.amount_kzt * r.kzt_rub, i.amount_vnd * r.vnd_rub), 2),
       CASE WHEN i.amount_kzt IS NOT NULL AND r.kzt_rub IS NOT NULL THEN 'kzt'
            WHEN i.amount_vnd IS NOT NULL AND r.vnd_rub IS NOT NULL THEN 'vnd' END,
       r.day, r.kzt_rub, r.vnd_rub, i.amount_key, i.dedup_key,
       '{{ $('Validate').first().json.sql_raw }}'
  FROM input i
  LEFT JOIN rate r ON true
 -- экран истории без времени: та же дата + сумма + продавец уже есть → дубль
 WHERE NOT EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM kaspi_expenses e
        WHERE e.op_date = i.op_date AND e.amount_key = i.amount_key
          AND e.merchant_norm = i.merchant_norm
          AND (NOT e.time_known OR NOT i.time_known))
ON CONFLICT (dedup_key) DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, op_date, time_known, merchant, type, amount_kzt, amount_vnd, amount_rub, kzt_rub, vnd_rub;
